en.headline: 225 own commits across 11 repos, five releases, and sandbox and skill tooling
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the OpenCode agent sandbox, skill management and model picker, plus three releases of the model picker and two of the pixel logo toolkit.
en.overview:
The window's work centered on a family of OpenCode-related tools. The largest single effort was `opencode-agent-sandbox`, where documentation and evaluation material were reworked: AGENTS.md was tightened with branch discipline and push-proxy notes, a knowledge-ingest command was added, and several evaluation entries were recorded or re-filed, including a SenseNova image skill quick reference and a correction that Windows does not need WSL2.

### Skill and model tooling

`opencode-skill-management` moved from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0. The four actions were changed to return a single JSON object with a declared output schema, the bilingual documentation site was synced to that contract, and a concurrency fix serialized disable/enable writes so parallel calls no longer overwrite each other. `opencode-go-model-picker` shipped 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1: priced accounting with Console calibration, a large documentation simplification that cut the model-facing text by roughly an order of magnitude, and a follow-up that enforced the candidate menu, per-source chains and a re-deriving check command.

### Pixel art and reporting

`pixel-logo-toolkit` released 0.2.0 and 0.3.0, adding a bilingual CLI, automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a Korean font fix (Ark Pixel's ko build lacks Hangul, so Galmuri is used), and a 40-image command gallery. `dsh-ecosystem-report` received mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 pixels, a single-button theme switcher with SVG favicon, visual refinements, and three additional plugins merged into its catalog. `dsh-openchamber-plugins` began porting OpenChamber features as DSH plugins, adding a hidden-files toggle and `/init` and zh-doc-sync skills.

### Profile, translation and blog

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` carried 13 own commits plus 572 automated commits, mainly daily-report and release-note pipeline work: a gate step validating generated output, full release notes fed to the AI summary, and fixes so block titles and totals describe issue actions rather than bare counts. `sopen-translate` documented the Google 2 key path and corrected the G2 status, and `myBlog` added screenshots of a DSH stats bug.

### Outside repositories

One pull request was opened on `opencode-agent-sandbox`. Issue activity included opening a PowerToys Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException report, opening an OpenChamber report that Settings > MCP omits the runtime Console MCP server, and commenting on an OpenChamber storage-management issue. Discussion activity took place on `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, including a workspace-write label and capability ACE thread and a Windows VS Code launch bug. No reviews were recorded, and no days in the window are missing data.

highlights.text: Released 2.0.0 with priced accounting, Console calibration and output v2.
Released 3.0.0, cutting the model-facing documentation from 104,181 to 8,291 characters.
Released 1.2.0, fixing false divergence warnings and frontmatter boolean normalization.
Released 0.3.0 with automatic text wrapping and overflow protection.
Opened an issue about Shortcut Guide Hold-Win activation throwing NullReferenceException.
Opened an issue that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库 225 次本人提交、5 个版本，沙箱与技能工具为主
zh.teaser: 本窗口主要投入 OpenCode 沙箱、技能管理与模型选择器，模型选择器发布三个版本，像素 Logo 工具发布两个版本。
zh.overview:
本窗口的工作集中在一组 OpenCode 相关工具上。投入最多的是 `opencode-agent-sandbox`，主要整理文档与评测材料：收紧 AGENTS.md 并补充分支纪律与推送代理说明，新增 knowledge-ingest 命令，登记或调整多条评测记录，包括 SenseNova 图像技能速查，以及 Windows 无需 WSL2 的实测纠正。

### 技能与模型工具

`opencode-skill-management` 从 1.1.0 升到 1.2.0：四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，中英文文档站同步该契约，并修复并发写互相覆盖的问题，disable/enable 改为串行。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1：带价格的计费与 Console 校准、把模型需读的文档压缩约一个数量级，以及后续强制候选菜单、按来源决定链长并让 check 重新推导数值。

### 像素图与报告

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 0.2.0 与 0.3.0，加入双语命令行、自动折行与溢出保护，修正韩语字体（Ark Pixel 的 ko 版不含谚文，改用 Galmuri），并补充 40 张命令示例画廊。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复 375 与 414 视口的移动端布局，主题切换改为单按钮加弹出菜单并补 SVG favicon，做视觉精修，并把 3 个插件并入资料库清单。`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 开始把 OpenChamber 功能移植为 DSH 插件，加入隐藏文件开关以及 `/init` 与 zh-doc-sync 技能。

### 个人主页、翻译与博客

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 13 次本人提交，另有 572 次自动提交，主要是日报与发布说明流水线：新增校验生成物的门禁步骤、把完整发布说明喂给 AI 摘要，并修正区块标题与 Totals 按 issue 动作数表述而非裸计数。`sopen-translate` 更正 G2 状态并记录 Google 2 密钥获取路径，`myBlog` 补充 DSH 统计页签缺陷的截图。

### 外部仓库

在 `opencode-agent-sandbox` 上开了 1 个 pull request。issue 方面，向 PowerToys 报告 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活抛 NullReferenceException，向 OpenChamber 报告设置中的 MCP 遗漏运行时 Console MCP 服务器，并在一个存储管理 issue 下留言。讨论活动发生在 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`，涉及 workspace-write 标签与能力 ACE 线程以及 Windows 下 VS Code 打开失败的缺陷。本窗口没有代码评审记录，也没有缺失数据的日期。

highlights.text: 发布 2.0.0，加入带价格的计费、Console 校准与输出 v2。
